metadataProvenance.mode: Unix permission/type bits stored in 7z Attributes and shown by original 7-Zip l -slt. These are packaged metadata, not proof of permissions before packaging.
metadataProvenance.timestamps: Strings retained verbatim from 7-Zip listing; timezone not inferred.
metadataProvenance.crc32: Per-member CRC32 from original 7z header; blank for entries where the format/listing has none.
unavailable: UID/GID and owner/group names not supplied by this 7z listing.
No inode/hardlink counts, btime/atime or link-target fields supplied.
metadataProvenance.hashes: Previously selected fingerprints attached only by same member path and stored size, without rehashing all members.

provenance.unknownPolicy: Blank means not supplied by the original format/listing or not previously measured, never zero.
provenance.pathPolicy: Archive member paths retained as relative paths; Windows display separators normalized to /. No extraction filesystem metadata used.

serialization: UTF-8 CSV, LF record separators; only the documented pwserver path decoding errors were corrected.

path_encoding_correction.method: Fresh 7-Zip UTF-8 listing decoded from binary stdout; all non-path fields and records outside pwserver preserved.
